claims.claim: Ps4 fat hacked with FC26 and 8 other games
claims.evidence: Witness report only shows a dual-tone gaming controller on a display board; no console, game discs/cases, or labels are shown.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired, no overheating, all ports working
claims.evidence: Witness report does not show a PS4 console or any ports being tested; it only shows a controller with no functional testing.

claims.claim: Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt
claims.evidence: Witness report shows only one controller on a board; no receipt or additional pads/accessories are shown.

risks.risk: Controller may be non-functional or have issues (button responsiveness, stick drift, vibration, triggers). Photos cannot confirm operation.
risks.proof: A short video showing power-on/connection (wired or Bluetooth), then a button test screen or on-screen input response for all buttons, both analog sticks centered and moved, and trigger presses; include vibration test if applicable.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a used controller with unknown functionality (worst-case: may have faults).

risks.risk: Brand/model and compatibility are unclear (PS4 vs Xbox vs generic/PC/mobile). The photo does not show readable branding/model.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of any brand/model text on the controller body and the back label/ports area, plus a screenshot/video of it connecting to the claimed platform (PS4) and working.

risks.risk: Wired vs wireless and missing receiver/charging accessories (cable, dongle, battery/charging status) are not shown.
risks.proof: Photo of the included items (cable/adapter/receiver) laid out, and a clip showing charging or wireless connection details (Bluetooth pairing screen or dongle use).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as controller-only with no guaranteed accessories.

risks.risk: Physical condition may be worse than it appears (hidden cracks, worn grips, damaged ports). The photo does not show close-ups of wear points.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of both analog sticks, D-pad, face buttons, shoulder/trigger areas, charging/port area, and both grips from multiple angles under light.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as cosmetically used with potential wear/imperfections.

risks.risk: The seller’s words appear to describe a PS4 console bundle, but the witness only saw a controller—possible mismatch or scam risk.
risks.proof: A clear photo/video of the actual item(s) being sold together: the PS4 fat console (front/back labels), the controller(s), and the game items/receipt if claimed.
risks.if_unproven: Priced only for the controller shown, not for any console/games/receipt.

proof_requests: Send close-up photos of the controller’s brand/model label (front/back) and any port/charging area.
Send a short video showing the controller connected to the claimed platform and a full button + both analog stick test (including triggers).
Confirm wired vs wireless and show what accessories are included (charging cable, receiver/dongle, battery/charging status).
Send close-up photos of grips and all buttons/shoulders/trigger areas for damage or missing parts.
If selling a PS4 fat bundle, send photos/videos of the PS4 fat console itself, the game items (FC26 + 8 others), and the UK receipt.
response.reason: The witness report clearly identifies a dual-tone gaming controller type, but all seller claims about a PS4 console, hacking, games, and receipts are not supported by what was shown. Price the controller at its worst-case used/unknown-functionality scenario until compatibility and working condition are proven.
